title: Set project capacity limits and baseline trust boundary

conditions.description: The scope is already settled by your earlier clarification: Jarvis-internal project and role caps first, covering manual and scheduled senders; account-wide/cross-project limits and external provider sessions are out of scope. Please specify the positive total project limit and explicit positive per-role limits (role name → integer). The policy schema rejects missing/unknown roles and fails closed for unlisted roles. If you do not want to choose values yet, explicitly defer and keep production admission HOLD; no defaults will be invented.

Choose the trust boundary for reconciling existing Jarvis-managed sessions before any generation-bound baseline: (A) accept a controlled, operator-attested drain as a human trust boundary—pause all in-scope senders, upgrade/retire old or offline clients, restrict alternate/direct launch paths, then drain and attest existing sessions; this is not machine-verifiable provider evidence and only supports the bounded cooperative Jarvis domain. (B) require provider-side complete session inventory plus terminal/no-send mediation; no such provider authority is currently available, so HOLD continues until it exists. (C) keep the system default-off/HOLD without choosing a drain method. This is a design prerequisite only: answering does not authorize a live drain, deployment, restart, activation or cutover; those require separate explicit approval after independent review.
